QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Versus Advanced Knights
QuestInfo.0: #bNeinheart#k, whom you met with in the #bSecret Grove#k, has a request.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Neinheart, after the Empress was warped by the Black Mage's influence, the Knights lost their free will and began following Cygnus without question. The Empress must be defeated to stop the Cygnus Knights... 

First, Neinheart said to defeat the #rAdvanced Knights#k closest to the Empress.

1.0: Have you eliminated the Advanced Knights?

yes.0: Good work. I'm sure this is a step toward peace for Maple World.

mob.0: Please defeat the #rAdvanced Knights#k closest to the Empress. I know you can do it.
